title: Zelensky reports that Bring Kids Back UA has returned more than 2,100 deported children
body:
On 22 April 2026 President Volodymyr Zelensky said that more than 2,100 Ukrainian children abducted by Russia had been brought back to Ukraine, of whom 150 were returned since the start of 2026. The figures were presented to him by representatives of the Bring Kids Back UA initiative, Oleksandr Bevz and Maksym Maksymov, according to the Kyiv Independent. A special commission under Ukraine's Ministry of Justice was still verifying data on each case. The initiative has traced and returned children from Russian-occupied territories and Russia since 2023.

Estimates of the number of deported children vary widely. Ukraine's Children of War database lists at least 20,000 children abducted since February 2022. Ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets has said the number could be up to 150,000, while Presidential Commissioner for Children's Rights Daria Herasymchuk has given a range of 200,000 to 300,000. Bring Kids Back UA says roughly 1.6 million children remain in occupied areas. Ukrainian officials believe the true number may be considerably higher than the documented figures.

Zelensky also announced a ministerial meeting of the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children in Brussels on 11 May. In March 2023 the International Criminal Court had issued arrest warrants for Vladimir Putin and Maria Lvova-Belova over the unlawful deportation of children.
